💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Strychnine Tree. Poison-nut tree (kuchila). The fruit looks friendly. The seeds are strychnine. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Dustboar: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Choir Toad: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nostalgia: Keep moving during the spell. The Home Movies beam needs your EYES — keep moving during the SPELL beat and the picture can't hold you. Diana sets aside time with the Big Ugly flesh. Look, smell, touch — then the smallest taste, and wait. Their tongue goes numb. Their stomach heaves. "NOT food," they gasp. "Poison." The Codex notes it in grim letters. You will not make this mistake twice — Diana already made it for you.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Poison Hemlock. Tall white umbels on smooth stems blotched purple. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

📚 Village knowledge: Sanne taught everyone about Poison Hemlock. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Sanne passes around Poison Hemlock. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
